name: Steam
description: Research Steam Store games in Persona. Read your library, achievements, updates, wishlist prices and playtime recaps, and track progress locally. Opt in to Friends Radar, wishlist alerts or gaming profile memory. Use Steam Mobile QR or a read-only Web API key.

auth_mode.title: Sign-in method
auth_mode.description: Defaults to Steam Mobile QR. Existing settings with a player ID and Web API key continue to use the key.

steam_id.title: Steam player ID
steam_id.description: For Web API key mode. Enter your 17-digit SteamID64 or the vanity name from your Steam profile URL.

country_code.title: Store country or region override
country_code.description: Leave blank to follow your signed-in account, with US as a fallback. Choose another country or region to compare prices or research games.

friends_radar_enabled.title: Friends Radar
friends_radar_enabled.description: Off by default. Enable it to read friends' online status and public game libraries in the Steam page and assistant tools.

inbox_events_enabled.title: Steam Inbox events
inbox_events_enabled.description: Check the wishlist automatically and alert you to deals, releases and demos. Turning this off stops background checks and uses zero extra AI tokens.

triage_rules.title: Triage rules
triage_rules.description: Write your own rules for sorting Steam wishlist alerts into Needs You, FYI, or Noise. For example, “Wishlist price drops are FYI.” Leave blank to use the global Inbox rules. Enter \n for a line break.

inbox_max_events_per_day.title: Daily Steam Inbox event limit
inbox_max_events_per_day.description: Maximum number of new Steam Inbox events per UTC day. Range 1–50, default 5.

wishlist_event_triggers.title: Wishlist alert triggers
wishlist_event_triggers.description: Choose which wishlist notifications to receive when Steam Inbox events are on. Each sale price, release or demo version is announced once.

wishlist_discount_threshold.title: Wishlist discount threshold (%)
wishlist_discount_threshold.description: Alert when the discount reaches this percentage. Range 1–100, default 50.

wishlist_target_prices.title: Wishlist target prices
wishlist_target_prices.description: Optional. Separate up to 20 rules with commas in AppID:CURRENCY:Steam price units format. For example, 123:USD:999 means $9.99.

patch_notes_summary_enabled.title: AI summaries of major updates
patch_notes_summary_enabled.description: Share short announcement excerpts with the assistant for summaries. Off by default, with headlines, dates, sources and links available.

sale_roundup_enabled.title: Wishlist sale roundups
sale_roundup_enabled.description: When at least three wishlist games are discounted, replace their individual price alerts with one roundup. Requires Steam Inbox events. Off by default.

memory_export_enabled.title: Export gaming profile to assistant memory
memory_export_enabled.description: Let Persona use a compact Steam gaming profile. Turning this off returns no entries, makes zero Steam requests, and uses zero extra context tokens. Off by default.

memory_export_dimensions.title: Gaming profile dimensions
memory_export_dimensions.description: Choose the details to share. All are selected by default. Clear all selections to stop exporting.

memory_max_items.title: Gaming profile export limit
memory_max_items.description: Export up to this many gaming profile entries. Range 1–100, default 20. Entries share a 2,048-byte text budget.

discovery_tools_enabled.title: Steam game research tools and skill
discovery_tools_enabled.description: Game research tools are on by default. The skill has a separate switch under Contributions and follows Hub delivery rules. Turning this setting off disables both.

discovery_max_results.title: Game research result limit
discovery_max_results.description: Maximum number of results per research call. Range 1–50, default 15. A game details batch is also capped at 10 games.

steam_api_key.title: Steam Web API key
steam_api_key.description: For Web API key mode. The Hub encrypts the key, and the extension sends it only to api.steampowered.com.
